structure.source: NIST CCCBDB experimental geometry, reference 1998Kuc (r C–F 1.315 Å; Cartesian distance 1.3151 Å)

notes.title: σ only
notes.text: σ only: each fluorine contributes one inward-pointing 2p σ orbital, as in SF6. Its other 2p orbitals (the π set and lone pairs) are left out, so this diagram shows the σ framework only.

notes.title: Compared with CH4
notes.text: Same tetrahedral pattern as CH4 (a1, t2), but the terminal orbital is fluorine's 2p σ (−18.65 eV), close to carbon's 2s (−19.43 eV) and well below carbon's 2p (−10.66 eV), instead of H 1s (−13.61 eV). The fluorine–fluorine contacts are on, as in SF6.
